correctness.rationale: The full translation trace follows from a complete classification of invariant simplex orbit graphs, the published homology concentration theorem, and oriented Lefschetz signs. Fourier orthogonality yields exact multiplicities. Distinct maximal parity tetrahedra separate coordinate three-cube cycles; their orbit sums exhaust the translation-fixed rank and transform by the exterior-cube sign. Finite signed-face computations were independently replayed.

value.rationale: For an infinite canonical metric family, the theorem determines every translation-isotypic multiplicity and a natural exterior-cube coordinate-permutation action on all invariant classes, with geometric generators and vanishing of full cube-invariant homology. These structural invariants are not determined by the known Betti numbers or sphere-wedge decomposition.
